annotations.title: Solana token rug check / safety scan

description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Rug-pull and safety check for any Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint (pump.fun memecoins included). Shows whether mint authority and freeze authority are revoked, supply and decimals, top-10 holder concentration, token age, metadata mutability, liquidity, and pump.fun bonding-curve or graduated status. Returns a 0-100 risk score with plain-English red flags. Not financial advice.
